items.title: What do the 15 theme presets include?
items.content: Five presets come from ui.shadcn.com/create. Ten are house designs: Aurora, Marine, Forest, Ember, Bloom, Lagoon, Gold, Midnight, Blossom and Citrus. Each one changes all 244 content elements at once.

items.title: How do per-page theme presets work?
items.content: Any page can set its own preset in the page properties, and its subpages inherit it. A campaign can use Midnight while the rest of the site stays on Aurora, with no rebuild.

items.title: Is dark mode part of every preset?
items.content: Yes. Every preset has light and dark colour tokens, with contrast checked against WCAG 2.2. Elements use semantic tokens, so dark mode needs no changes per element.

items.title: Can I build a custom preset?
items.content: Yes. Create a theme on ui.shadcn.com/create or write your own token file, then register it as the custom preset. All 62 components use it straight away. We also adapt presets to your brand, from €1,990.

items.title: Do theme switches affect my content?
items.content: No. Presets only change design tokens and CSS. Every headline, image and link your editors entered stays as it was. You can restyle the whole site without touching a single record.
